external_collaboration.evidence_quote: HOKA are the Official Running Shoe of the IRONMAN and IRONMAN 70.3 Global Series.

ROKA Is the Official Swimwear Partner of the IRONMAN Global Series. ROKA designs and manufactures premium and technical apparel for people who are out there getting after it, both competitively and recreationally. ROKA makes high-quality tools that you can count on for optical protection or optical correction. All of their products are built for action and use patented and proprietary technology to meet the demands of the world's most extreme athletes.
Breitling are the Official Luxury Watch Partner of the IRONMAN & IRONMAN 70.3 Global Series.

ROUVY redefines indoor cycling with the most realistic riding experience available. With over 1,500 stunning video routes filmed on location worldwide, you can train, explore, and stay motivated year-round. As the Official Digital Sports Platform of IRONMAN, ROUVY delivers training on virtual IRONMAN bike courses, precision workouts, and seamless app integrations to get triathletes race-ready.
AG1 are the Official Foundational Nutrition Supplement Partner of the IRONMAN and IRONMAN 70.3 Global Series.
Athletic Brewing Company, is the Official Non-Alcoholic Beer of the IRONMAN and IRONMAN 70.3 Global Series.
Hyperice is the Official Recovery Technology Partner of IRONMAN and IRONMAN 70.3 Global Series.
Maurten are the Official Sports Nutrition Partner of the IRONMAN and IRONMAN 70.3 Global series.

Precision Fuel & Hydration are proud to provide the on-course hydration for the IRONMAN and IRONMAN 70.3 Global Series. Trusted by a long list of age-group and pro triathletes, including reigning IRONMAN World Champion Solveig Løvseth and 2x IRONMAN 70.3 Champion Jelle Geens, their PH 1000 electrolyte drink will be available in bottles on the bike and cups on the run. Nirvana are the Official Athlete Premium Experience & Official Travel Partner to IRONMAN & IRONMAN 70.3 global series.

Wahoo Fitness are an Official Technical Partner of the IRONMAN & IRONMAN 70.3 Global Series, covering their whole ecosystem of products including Watch, Heart Rate Monitor, Bicycle Computer, Bicycle Trainer, Bicycle Pedal, Treadmill, Indoor Bike, Cadence Sensor and Speed Sensor.
Qatar Airways is the Official Airline Partner of the IRONMAN and IRONMAN 70.3 Global Series.

TriDot are the Official Training Platform, Official Swim Training Program, and Official Coach Certification Program of IRONMAN and IRONMAN 70.3 Global Series. Leveraging more than two decades of ongoing research, TriDot’s patents-pending technology uses athlete biometrics, training data, and coach inputs along with its own proprietary dataset, artificial intelligence, and other advanced analytics to optimize training for each individual athlete.
